newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: LCI FILES CLAIM AGAINST MOTOROLA.
newsitem.headline: LCI FILES CLAIM AGAINST MOTOROLA.

text.p: LCI Computer Group NV said on Tuesday it had filed a request for arbitration in which it was seeking $116 million in damages from Motorola Computer Group.
LCI said its arbitration request was lodged with the Arbitral Tribunal of CEPINA, the Centre for the Study and Practise of National and International Arbitration in Brussels.
It said Motorola Computer Group was the trading name used by a group of companies including Motorola Inc. of the U.S. and various European Motorola subsidiaries.

LCI alleges that Motorola Computer Group (MCG) had failed to provide it with products and infringed LCI's exclusive rights in Benelux markets by announcing a distribution agreement with Bull S.A. in November 1996.
The Dutch company said it had previously signed an exclusive partnership agreement with MCG for the development of Motorola PowerPC systems in Benelux.
LCI said its claim for damages included the loss of profit.
